title: New Year's Eve fondue (white Meltie mug, snowy cabin nye) — NYE 08
notes: New Year's Eve restage 08 of the "I love this mug!!" Short (shorts/uMl76XX7epo): WHITE variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photos), on the rustic pine table (a rustic pine table in a snowy cabin on New Year's Eve, a frosty window with snow outside, gold string lights and a small paper "Happy New Year" garland without letters (plain gold stars)). New Year's Eve decor instead of pumpkins; reworded NYE hook. The pour and the last dip spill on purpose. Laptop: generated fictional New Year's film stills (no real footage); plain unbranded red bag; no brand labels on bottles; Sora audio.

setting.style: Festive New Year's Eve night at home, at a SNOWY CABIN NEW YEAR: everything happens on the rustic pine table; a dim festive room lit only by gold string lights and a stove glow and the candle, deep soft shadows, no bright studio light. Handheld vertical phone video at table height, shallow depth of field, rich warm gold-and-black party colour grade with sparkle. Hands have long glossy deep-red manicured nails. The laptop screen is always flat chroma-key green. No on-screen text, no logos, no readable numbers.
